page_note: Heavily damaged page (81% damage ratio). Core teaching is the bitter-tree / good-tree correspondence: bitter tree = matter, bitter land = darkness/death, beautiful land = light without death. This is substrate correspondential mapping (tree→matter, land→cosmic domain). Editorial seam fires at i=26 ('ⲉⲧⲃⲉ ⲡⲉⲓ' / 'on account of this') introducing a brief hortatory aside addressing 'my beloved' (i=26-29), after which the cosmological exposition resumes (i=30-35). Editorial fatigue confirms the pattern: hortatory drift +6.2 in second half. Despite damage, the bitter-tree teaching structure remains visible.
